hero__subheading: A community charity grounded in practical support, dignity, connection, and real pathways forward.

who_we_are__heading: A community charity built around real life
who_we_are__intro: Oakdene House Foundation is based in Western Sydney but supports people and families across the greater Sydney region affected by addiction, hardship, homelessness, and other life challenges. Our work is shaped by the belief that support should be respectful, practical, and accessible, especially when life feels unstable or overwhelming.
mission_vision_values__text_2: To support people and families through practical help, connection, and pathways that strengthen wellbeing, dignity, and community belonging.
mission_vision_values__text_4: A community where people facing hardship are met with respect, support, and genuine opportunities to move forward.
mission_vision_values__text_5: We treat every person with respect and without judgment.
mission_vision_values__text_6: We focus on what helps in real life, not just what sounds good on paper.
mission_vision_values__text_7: We believe people do better when they feel seen, supported, and part of a community.
mission_vision_values__text_8: We stay focused on progress, possibilities, and the next step.
our_approach__text: Oakdene works in a way that is practical, person-centred, and community-based. We meet people where they are, help respond to immediate needs, and create pathways into longer-term support where needed.
our_approach__text_2: We do not see people as problems to be fixed. We see people as capable of change when they have the right support, the right environment and the right relationships around them.
what_we_do__list: Peer support through GA and AA meetings
Community access through Oakdene Kitchen, Oakdene Laundrette and Oakdene Boutique
Volunteer pathways for people who want to give back
